title: Modulation of Estrogen Receptor Activity by the Phytoalexin Tuberosin Produced from Elicited Kudzu (Pueraria lobata).
authors: Belgodere, Jorge A; Elliott, Jack R; Benz, Megan C; Kpeli, G Wills; Elliott, Steven; Ponder, Isaac J; Sanga Pema, Geoffroy E R; Ma, Peng; Dietrich, Sophie R; Cheng, Thomas; Nguyen, Khoa; Tilghman, Syreeta L; Zou, Binghao; Anbalagan, Muralidharan; Rowan, Brian G; Newman, Robert H; Mondrinos, Mark; Sridhar, Jayalakshmi; Wiese, Thomas E; Ali, Simak; Hoang, Van T; Collins-Burow, Bridgette M; Martin, Elizabeth C; Abbas, Hamed K; Boue, Stephen M; Burow, Matthew E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物抗毒素tuberosin对雌激素受体ER的调控作用，虽含分子对接模拟蛋白-配体结合，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦TF-DNA体系，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Kudzu's invasive nature has contributed to its classification as a weed, as it frequently outcompetes native plant species, leading to extensive overgrowth. Efforts to control kudzu have proven challenging, with moderate success using physical or biological agents. In this study, we evaluated the effects of two such control agents, ultraviolet C radiation and Myrothecium verrucaria, to significantly increase the production of tuberosin, a phytoalexin isoflavone. Our findings demonstrate that estrogenic activity of tuberosin is cell-type-dependent, displaying antagonist or competitive inhibition when combined with 17-beta-estradiol in the estrogen receptor (ER) positive cell lines MCF-7 and T-47D, while showing dose-dependent agonist activity in HEK293 cells transfected to express both ER receptors (alpha and beta). Tuberosin was shown to modulate ER pathways, alter ER-mediated gene expression, and increase cell proliferation in a dose-dependent manner while maintaining expression of the ERalpha protein. Binding affinity and docking simulations confirmed tuberosin binding to the ERalpha pocket in a similar but weaker manner compared to synthetic estrogen. Tuberosin-treated endothelial cells suppressed vascular network assembly and maturation without affecting the cellular proliferative capacity. The presented studies leverage current kudzu management methods to naturally produce tuberosin, examine cell-type-specific effects, and support further investigation as an antiestrogen for breast cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 葛藤（kudzu）的入侵性使其被归类为杂草，因为它经常排挤本地植物物种，导致大面积过度生长。控制葛藤的努力一直颇具挑战性，使用物理或生物制剂仅取得中等成功。在本研究中，我们评估了两种此类控制剂——紫外线C辐射和疣孢漆斑菌（Myrothecium verrucaria）——对显著提高块茎素（tuberosin）产量的效果，块茎素是一种植物抗毒素异黄酮。我们的研究结果表明，块茎素的雌激素活性具有细胞类型依赖性，在雌激素受体（ER）阳性细胞系MCF-7和T-47D中，与17-β-雌二醇联合使用时表现出拮抗或竞争性抑制作用，而在转染表达两种ER受体（α和β）的HEK293细胞中则表现出剂量依赖性的激动剂活性。块茎素被证明可调节ER通路，改变ER介导的基因表达，并以剂量依赖性方式增加细胞增殖，同时维持ERα蛋白的表达。结合亲和力和对接模拟证实，块茎素以与合成雌激素相似但较弱的方式结合到ERα口袋。块茎素处理的内皮细胞抑制了血管网络组装和成熟，而不影响细胞增殖能力。所呈现的研究利用当前的葛藤管理方法自然生产块茎素，检查细胞类型特异性效应，并支持其作为抗雌激素用于乳腺癌治疗的进一步研究。
